name: htop
purpose: Interactive, colour-coded live process viewer with visual CPU/memory bars.
explanation: A more user-friendly, interactive alternative to top showing colour-coded CPU and memory usage and visual CPU bars. Press 'q' to quit.
expectedOutput: (Interactive colour-coded process monitor; press q to quit)
whenToUse: To visually spot CPU-hungry runaway processes and find their PIDs.
commonMistakes: Assuming htop is pre-installed on every system without installing it via a package manager if needed.
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `htop` in a standard Unix-like shell.
commonErrors: zsh: command not found: htop (if not installed or missing from PATH)
